server.name: community-prompt-optimizer
server.version: claude-prompt-optimizer-mcp (npm latest at image build time)
server.note: Drawn in frame order at position 637 of Frame 3, block 6. Twenty tools, none annotated. State lives under HOME/.prompt-control-plane: one file per session under sessions/ named by a generated id, plus usage.json (the free tier's metered count) and stats.json. Sessions are observed as a tally with id, created_at and last_accessed declared away; usage.json and stats.json as JSON documents with their time stamps declared away, counts kept.

arguments.raw_prompt: Write a function that sums a list of numbers.

fixtures.note: Compiles one prompt, which opens a session and counts against the free tier. get_usage reads the meter back.
